questions.title: Uniform order-statistic spacings and the Dirichlet law
questions.description: Focused L0 known-result evaluation grounded in R. Pyke, Spacings, Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series B 27(3) (1965), 395-436, DOI 10.1111/j.2517-6161.1965.tb00602.x, with SciPy and NumPy Dirichlet implementations as public computational context. Let U_1,...,U_n be iid Uniform(0,1), n>=1, write U_(0)=0<U_(1)<...<U_(n)<U_(n+1)=1 almost surely, and define the n+1 endpoint spacings D_i=U_(i)-U_(i-1). In one authoritative Markdown/LaTeX Theory workspace, derive the ordered-sample density from the iid density and permutation regions, transform from order statistics to the first n spacings with an explicit inverse map, support, dimension, reference measure, and Jacobian, and identify the complete spacing vector as Dirichlet(1,...,1). Derive the constant joint density, exchangeability, each Beta(1,n) marginal, E[D_i], Var(D_i), and Cov(D_i,D_j) for i!=j. Explain why the spacings are dependent despite identical beta marginals, handle n=1, and distinguish strict positivity almost surely from deterministic samples with ties or endpoint observations. Do not omit either endpoint spacing, use an (n+1)-dimensional Lebesgue density on a measure-zero hyperplane, replace n! by another factorial, or treat simulation or a library call as proof. The required model-authored Python artifact is est_uniform_order_spacings and must implement run_estimator(request) exactly for the frozen public sample-to-spacings contract. Reusing sorting utilities is allowed when exact input validation, endpoint construction, sample identity, and evidence boundaries are preserved. Exploratory Python or R may check Jacobians, simplex moments, and boundary examples. A separately frozen confirmatory assessment uses predeclared iid Uniform(0,1) sample sizes, seeds, and replicate counts to compare all spacing means, variances, and off-diagonal covariances with their exact Dirichlet values while reporting Monte Carlo uncertainty. That finite-sample moment assessment is implementation evidence, not a proof of the joint distribution. Source-code replication, novelty, asymptotics, goodness-of-fit testing, maximal-spacing theory, and Lean formalization are not applicable.

primary_paper.title: Spacings
primary_paper.journal: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series B (Methodological)

request_fields.name: sample
request_fields.meaning: A realized finite sample whose order statistics partition the unit interval.
request_fields.shape: one nonempty finite numeric array of length n
request_fields.indexing: sample entries have no intrinsic order; every entry must be preserved through sorting
request_fields.edge_cases: Values at zero or one and repeated values are valid deterministic inputs and may create zero spacings. Reject nonarrays, empty arrays, booleans, strings, nonnumeric values, nonfinite values, values outside [0,1], and silently coerced or dropped entries.

response_fields.name: sorted_sample
response_fields.meaning: All request values sorted in nondecreasing order.
response_fields.shape: one finite numeric array with the same length as sample
response_fields.indexing: ascending order statistics with multiplicity preserved
response_fields.edge_cases: Ties and endpoint values are preserved exactly up to ordinary floating arithmetic.

response_fields.name: spacings
response_fields.meaning: The complete endpoint-spacing vector induced by sorted_sample.
response_fields.shape: one finite nonnegative numeric array of length n+1
response_fields.indexing: first spacing is sorted_sample[0]-0, interior spacings are successive differences, and final spacing is 1-sorted_sample[-1]
response_fields.edge_cases: Ties or endpoint observations may create exact zero entries; the spacing sum remains one.

invariants.meaning: The request contains exactly sample and the response contains exactly sorted_sample and spacings. Missing or extra fields and invalid values are rejected rather than ignored, repaired, or coerced.
The returned spacings are nonnegative, have length len(sample)+1, include both endpoint gaps, and sum to one up to ordinary floating arithmetic.
Permuting request sample entries leaves both response arrays unchanged.
Replacing every sample value x by 1-x reverses the spacing vector and maps sorted_sample to the sorted reflected sample.

empirical_claims.meaning: Before outcomes, freeze each sample size, iid Uniform(0,1) generator, seed, replicate count, exact Dirichlet moment targets, estimator invocation, and Monte Carlo decision rule.

For every frozen sample size, compare every spacing mean and variance and every off-diagonal covariance with the exact Dirichlet(1,...,1) values, reporting standardized Monte Carlo discrepancies or equivalent uncertainty.

The confirmatory assessment checks the executable spacing map and finite-sample moments only for the frozen iid Uniform(0,1) designs. It does not prove the joint density, independence, asymptotics, maximal-spacing results, goodness-of-fit validity, source replication, novelty, or formal correctness.
